baseline: 172 current source; no protected app/controller/host files changed by this task
rootCauseStatus: 171 regression is narrowed to the custom batch/shader interaction, but no unique faulty line is proven. This controlled build removes cross-child batching only for actual LOD edge pairs so root can run same-camera A/B.

controlledBehavior.ordinaryTiles: Use SDK DrawableSurfaceTexture and SurfaceTextureProgram four-slot batching. In the Mercator wrapper, only a tile with own child texture, nonzero actual LOD edge mask, and resident ancestor texture gets NativeRasterFeatherDrawable.
controlledBehavior.pairDraw: One draw per boundary drawable; slot 0/unit 0 samples parent and slot 1/unit 5 samples child. Pair shader uses each slot's official texScaleTrans, texRect and texOpacity, then premultiplied RGBA mix. It does not apply Mercator-specific shader uniforms because WorldWind 2.1.1 has none; MercatorImageTile CPU reprojects decoded rows and SurfaceTextureProgram consumes the resulting coordTransform plus tile sector matrix.
controlledBehavior.fallback: No edge or no parent stays on SDK batching and opaque own image. If child binding fails after queueing, draw cached parent only for that tile; if parent bind fails, draw own child only. No extra fetch or CPU bitmap copy.
controlledBehavior.fixedSurface: NativeRasterFeatherSurfaceImage uses super.doRender when edge mask is zero or resident parent is missing; only a real fixed-detail pair enters controlled shader. NativeRasterDetailLayer remains unwired in this integration phase.
controlledBehavior.pixelScale: No process-global ratio. Each drawable carries cssPixelScale; its MercatorSurfaceImage receives a per-view provider and writes that value into the shader for that pair. Provider must be the map view's physical-pixels-per-CSS-pixel value from its own viewport, not a shared static or assumed Android density. The width targets 6 CSS px and clamps to 1/16 of tile UV span. Default ratio 1 is only a safe fallback until viewport scale is supplied.

minimalAppWiring.NativeMapController: Keep existing print-tracked branch unchanged. In the ordinary Mercator raster branch of makeTileSurfaceImage, construct NativeRasterFeatherMercatorSurfaceImage instead of MercatorTiledImageLayer.buildTiledSurfaceImage; pass a provider backed by a new per-controller raster CSS ratio updated by a dedicated setter.
minimalAppWiring.NativeCartographyLayers: Add optional cssPixelScale provider to constructor and forward it to NativeImageryBasemap. Each instance is per WorldWindow, so primary and comparison panes retain independent values.
minimalAppWiring.NativeImageryBasemap: Add optional cssPixelScale provider and use NativeRasterFeatherMercatorSurfaceImage in its private surface factory for overview and selected raster imagery; pass provider and backing=null. Its Mercator addTile already exposes the actual same-frame ancestor Texture, so base-LOD feather needs no separate cache or fetch.
minimalAppWiring.HostViewport: When a map's viewport payload computes its own cssScale, call that map controller's dedicated setRasterCssPixelScale(cssScale). Do not reuse a global cssScale; do not assume displayMetrics.density equals CSS scale.
